description: Retrieve exactly one authored tier for a published kingy.wiki guide: nudge/hint_1, hint_2, or solution. The default is hint_1. The response contains only the requested tier, its source links and evidence limitations; an explicitly requested solution may also include clip moments for that solution. Pages without the requested authored tier return hint_unavailable. No hints or game mechanics are generated.
name: get_hint
title: Get one authored Kingy hint
